sites.rationale: The ledger (PMC9825563) names S898 as the reference residue. Python verification confirms sequence[898]='S'. The phrase 'positioned at position S898' is slightly ambiguous (before or after S898); I interpret it as insert_after_residue=898 (tag inserted after S898), giving residue_before='S' and residue_after='R' (sequence[899]='R'). The alternative reading (insert_after_residue=897, before S898) is also in ECL4 and satisfies all constraints; the ±1 uncertainty does not affect qualification. Both 897 and 898 are within ECL4 (880–917, extracellular). Distance from TM7 end (879): 19 aa; distance from TM8 start (918): 20 aa — well above the ≥3 aa minimum. This is a distinct junction from the FLAG site at 901, reported by a different paper, and is therefore a separate site. Ranked below the FLAG site because no surface or functional validation is reported in the ledger. Triple HA tag (3xHA) inserted at position S898 in ECL4 of full-length CFTR by Gibson assembly to generate the TMD2-3HA construct (PMC9825563). The construct was expressed from pBI-CMV2-CFTR backbone. No surface or functional assay result is described in the ledger quote for this specific construct. [validation: not_measured; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The TMD2-3HA construct was generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR and a gene block consisting of triple HA, with 3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR.

sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunofluorescence (non-permeabilized cells): wt-CFTR-FLAG reaches the plasma membrane; F508del-CFTR-FLAG does not — consistent with known trafficking defect, not a tag-induced artefact. Ion-channel function NOT MEASURED in these studies.
sites.rationale: The ledger (PMC4356983) names the junction explicitly: between Asn901 and Ser902. Python verification confirms sequence[901]='N' and sequence[902]='S', matching the paper's Asn901/Ser902. Both residues fall within ECL4 (topology landmark 880–917, extracellular). Distance from TM7 C-terminus (residue 879): 22 aa; distance from TM8 N-terminus (residue 918): 17 aa — well beyond the ≥3 aa minimum. PMC4405497 independently confirms 'FLAG octapeptide (DYKDDDDK) after residue N901' in a lentiviral vector, providing a second paper grounding the same junction. insert_after_residue=901 is unambiguous. FLAG octapeptide (DYKDDDDK) inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in the fourth extracellular loop (ECL4) of full-length CFTR. Surface display confirmed by immunofluorescence without cell permeabilization: wt-CFTR-FLAG is detectable at the plasma membrane; F508del-CFTR-FLAG is not, validating the construct as a trafficking reporter. Independently reproduced in a lentiviral stable-expression system (PMC4405497). [validation: surface_only; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: Additionally, a Flag sequence (DYKDDDDK) was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902, i.e., in the fourth extracellular loop of CFTR ( Fig. 1a–c ).

sites.functional_impact_measured: PM bioluminescence (extracellular HiBiT assay, non-lytic): WT-CFTR-HiBiT detected at plasma membrane. G542X-CFTR-HiBiT PM expression quantified and modulated by TRIDs and CFTR modulators. Ion-channel function NOT MEASURED in these studies.
sites.rationale: PMC10622324 reports HiBiT knock-in into ECL4 at two positions but does not name the residue numbers in the ledger quote. PMC12932761 corroborates HiBiT in the extracellular domain of CFTR with PM detection. Because no junction residue is named, insert_after_residue is left null and region is set to 'ECL4' (topology landmark 880–917). The two already-validated junctions in ECL4 (898 and 901) are the most likely candidates, but this ledger entry cannot be collapsed into either without inventing a junction. Ranked below the residue-pinned sites. cited_tag_residue is null because no residue is named in the supporting quote. HiBiT tag knocked into ECL4 of endogenous WT-CFTR at two candidate positions via CRISPR/Cas9 (PMC10622324). Bioluminescence-based quantification used for both total (lytic) and plasma-membrane-localized (extracellular, non-permeabilized) CFTR. Additionally, HiBiT fused to the extracellular domain of full-length G542X-CFTR in stable BEAS-2B cells enabled PM expression quantification (PMC12932761). The ledger quotes do not name specific residue numbers for the HiBiT junctions. [validation: surface_only; position: inferred; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: We investigated two potential positions for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of HiBiT in the ECL4 of WT-CFTR ( Fig 1A ) for bioluminescence-based quantification of both total endogenous levels (lytic assay) and live-cell detection of WT-CFTR in the PM (extracellular assay).

literature_notes: Disqualified ledger entries: (1) mCherry fused to the N-terminus of CFTR (PMC4356983, PMC8976878) — CFTR has no signal peptide; the N-terminus (residues 1–77) is intracellular per the topology landmarks, so this is not an extracellular tag. (2) SpyTags at both N- and C-termini of full-length CFTR (PMC13056111) — the N-terminus (1–77) and C-terminus (1148–1480) are both intracellular; electrophysiological function was confirmed but neither terminus is extracellular, so these do not qualify as extracellular tag sites. No other extracellular loops of CFTR (ECL1: 94–124; ECL2: 219–222; ECL3: 325–347; ECL5: 1012; ECL6: 1122–1126) are supported by any ledger entry.
